description.value: The Campbell River Curling Club has been a cornerstone of the community since opening in 1964, growing from a volunteer-built facility into a member-owned club with around 375 active curlers across leagues spanning juniors, seniors, and adaptive programs including Special Olympics and Blind and Vision Impaired curling. The facility features five sheets of ice maintained by a professional ice technician and an upstairs lounge with darts, pool, shuffleboard, and big-screen TVs, along with a professional kitchen serving meals and local beers on tap. A touring cyclist arriving in Campbell River during the curling season would find a genuine, long-established community hub with on-site food and drink.

judgement.verdict_reason: policy: members/league club, no walk-in public offering

Café or food on site.detail: Website states 'professional kitchen, where meals are prepared by paid kitchen staff' and lounge with 'great food with local beers on tap'; all servers and bartenders are club employees

wow_evidence: Member-owned club since 1964 (KW-PRIVATE); notable adaptive programs but members-focused.
blurb: Campbell River's five-sheet member-owned curling club.
